label: Online Nevada Encyclopedia ID
wrong_values: name_preferred 'Mark Twain: A Life' (a Further Reading title, Ron Powers)
name_preferred 'A Companion to Mark Twain' (Further Reading title)
name_preferred 'Mark Twain: The Bachelor Years' (Further Reading title, Margaret Sanborn)
type sioc:Item / foaf:Document (page/document type, not the person)
missing: Both records render two full signed articles: 'Mark Twain' by Lawrence Berkove, 16 Nov 2009, and 'Samuel Clemens' by Ronald James, 30 Jul 2009. None of their content is in the profile, and page_text_values = 0. The profile only has 15 values from the site's front-page RSS feed. Missing from the articles: birth 1835 Florida, Missouri; places Carson City, Aurora, Unionville, Virginia City, San Francisco, Hartford, Buffalo, Elmira; the early penname 'Josh'; the first 'Mark Twain' byline (Feb 1863); related people (brother Orion, Horace Bixby, Joe Goodman, Dan De Quille/William Wright, Artemus Ward, Rollin Daggett, Steve Gillis, wife Olivia Langdon 1870); about 15 works with years (Roughing It 1872, Innocents Abroad 1869, Jumping Frog 1869, Gilded Age 1874, Tom Sawyer 1876, Life on the Mississippi 1883, Huckleberry Finn 1884-85, Connecticut Yankee 1889, Pudd'nhead Wilson 1894, Following the Equator 1897, Letters from the Earth...); occupations (steamboat pilot, reporter, miner); article authors and dates; further-reading citations; geographic tags (Storey County, Washoe County, Incline Village).
label_issues: status 'http_error×2' and resolved false are wrong in practice. Both URLs rendered the full articles in the browser, so the HTTP error code was cosmetic. Status should be ok and resolved true. format_family 'embedded markup' (rdfa) reflects only an RSS/RDFa side channel; the real content is page text. uniqueness 'mixed' is computed from 9 mostly irrelevant values.
notable: This is the 'tagline/side-feed counted as data' failure class. The profile describes the site's front-page RSS feed item, not the two encyclopedia articles that Wikidata links to.

label: National Library of Lithuania ID
missing: Nothing substantial. Names, Lithuanian/Russian variants, notes, occupations, dates, places, 810 sources, the VLE link, works and VIAF 998 links are all present.
label_issues: format_family 'ad-hoc JSON/XML' is misleading. The payload is a UNIMARC authority record serialised by VIAF as JSON (mx:record/datafield), which is a library format. Note that the structured 'via' tags (100, 400, 500, 678, 856) use MARC21 tag names for a UNIMARC record (e.g. the UNIMARC 300/340 notes appear as '678').
notable: The VIAF 998 cluster includes LC n82045653 'Twain, Mark (Spirit)'. It was correctly excluded.

label: Slovak National Library (VIAF) ID
missing: Nothing substantial. Works are capped at 40 on purpose.
label_issues: format_family 'ad-hoc JSON/XML' should be 'library format': it is a MARC21 authority record in VIAF's JSON. The 'mostly unique (71%)' bucket is inflated by 206 related_agent values. These are VIAF-derived co-contributor names from bibliographic records (translators, illustrators, editors) with no relation stated, not data from the Slovak authority itself.
notable: The second Wikidata value, vtls011128952, is the Slovak pseudonym record 'Conte, Louis de, 1835-1910', which is legitimately his. The LC '(Spirit)' cluster member was flagged and excluded.

missing: Works: the page says 'Opere (35)' but shows only 8, and the rest sit behind a JS 'Carica tutte le opere' button. The profile has 6 works, so about 29 are missing. label_issues: access 'js-rendered page only' and format_family 'embedded markup' are wrong. FactGrid is a Wikibase: Special:EntityData/Q273620.json/.ttl and a SPARQL endpoint serve the full item by plain HTTP, and the item page is server-rendered MediaWiki. It should be plain HTTP / RDF.
